name: qq-ai-bot
description: Local QQ AI assistant with DeepSeek
author: QQ AI Bot contributors

scripts.lint:staged: eslint --config eslint.config.cjs tests/p2-*.test.cjs tests/p2-*.browser.cjs scripts/check-browser-assets.cjs scripts/write-release-report.cjs
scripts.format:check:staged: prettier --end-of-line auto --check src/budget.ts src/idempotency.ts src/tracked-model.ts src/ipc-input.ts tests/p2-*.test.cjs tests/p2-*.browser.cjs scripts/check-browser-assets.cjs scripts/write-release-report.cjs eslint.config.cjs ui/budget.css docs/current-release.md .github/workflows/offline-ci.yml
scripts.ci:offline: npm run typecheck && npm run check:browser-assets && npm run lint:staged && npm run format:check:staged && npm test
scripts.pack:win: npm run preflight:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && node scripts/write-launcher-manifest.cjs && node scripts/write-release-report.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run preflight:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
